title: disbursement tranche the seeded draw recorded (detail read-back)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json (GET /working-capital-loans/1, tenant gerege): the disbursementDetails block of the seeded draw. The draw recorded one tranche on m_wc_loan_disbursement_detail: principal=1000.51 and actualAmount=1000.51. expect.detail.disbursement.principal="100051" and .actual_amount="100051" transcribe those two money cells as integer minor units. WHAT THIS VECTOR DISCRIMINATES: a draw write path that credits the m_wc_loan_balance row but never records the tranche row (registered as workingcapital-wrong-tranche-dropped) renders NO disbursement block on the detail read-back, so this vector goes red under it — WC-02, which pins no tranche cell, cannot see that defect. The mandatory detail cells (id, status, the nine balance cells) are re-pinned because the detail comparator grades them on every detail vector; they are the same captured cells WC-02 already pins.

provenance.note: Every expect field is transcribed from the committed capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json; capture_case_id names the seeded loan whose disbursementDetails block holds the tranche.
